key_insights: BTC had a strong opening drive in October but opening drives tend to be mean-reverting
The 28.1-28.2 level is confluent resistance (monthly midpoint, weekly midpoint, daily resistance)
ETH/BTC weakness continues despite futures narrative which appears to be sell-the-news
LINK and SOL are outliers but both facing significant resistance at current levels
Macro environment not supportive with S&P closing weak and dollar looking strong
summary: BTC had a strong October opening rally but is now at a confluent resistance zone of 28.1-28.2 which represents the midpoint of both monthly and weekly ranges. Cred prefers to wait for either a pullback to 27.2-27.4 or a daily flip of 28.1-28.2 before getting bullish. ETH/BTC weakness continues with the futures narrative appearing to be sell-the-news. LINK and SOL remain in ranges with LINK facing year-long resistance and SOL at monthly $24 resistance. Macro backdrop is not supportive with weak S&P and strong dollar.
